target_profile.system_boundary: The github.com/hashicorp/raft library, including its protocol orchestration and available repository-owned adapters. Application FSM implementations and separately maintained storage backends are outside the supplied implementation evidence; built-in adapters remain within the discovery frontier.
protocol_contexts: Raft terms, server identities, voter membership and indexed typed log entries.
Candidate elections with optional pre-vote and a leadership-transfer bypass.
Asynchronous FSM application, snapshot capture and snapshot restore.
Versioned protocol messages, membership encoding and snapshot encoding.
external_interfaces: Apply, ApplyLog, Barrier and VerifyLeader return futures.
Transport supplies RPC delivery, pipelining, snapshot streaming and optional heartbeat fast-pass handling.
WithPreVote optionally supplies pre-vote RPC support.
FSM, BatchingFSM and FSMSnapshot supply application callbacks.
Log storage and snapshot storage are accessed through r.logs and r.snapshots; complete interface definitions remain unread.
Observer channels carry selected events; delivery implementation remains unread.
ownership: runCandidate processes candidate-state events in the main protocol loop.
commitment serializes voter-index and commit-index access with a mutex.
runFSM owns local application progress variables and callback helpers.
takeSnapshot requests FSM capture and separately requests configuration state owned by the main thread.
installSnapshot coordinates snapshot storage, an asynchronous FSM restore request and protocol metadata updates.
FileSnapshotSink implements repository-owned file finalization and publication.
selection_injection: runFSM selects BatchingFSM and ConfigurationStore behavior through interface assertions on r.fsm.
installSnapshot selects full old-log removal when r.logs implements MonotonicLogStore and reports IsMonotonic; otherwise it selects compaction.
Transport permits implementations to ignore SetHeartbeatHandler and deliver heartbeats through Consumer instead.
Constructor wiring, available storage implementations and active transport/storage variants require source acquisition.
variants: Pre-vote enabled versus disabled; leadership transfer bypasses pre-vote.
Optional ConfigurationStore in the single-entry path.
Legacy peer-list versus explicit configuration snapshot metadata.
Monotonic log-store cleanup versus trailing-log compaction.
File snapshot synchronization depends on noSync and operating system.
Protocol-version-dependent membership encoding is documented; active version is unknown.
